name: CustomXMLParts
description: Represents a collection of CustomXMLPart objects.
remarks: There are three default parts that are always created with a document. These are cover pages, doc properties, and app properties. The last two were in previous versions of Microsoft Word but are now provided in XML form in the CustomXMLParts object collection.
example:
Sub AddPartToCollection()
    Dim myPart As CustomXMLPart

    Set myPart = ActiveDocument.CustomXMLParts.Add("<author>Mark Twain</author>")

End Sub

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the CustomXMLParts object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the CustomXMLParts object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the CustomXMLParts object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets a Long indicating the number of items in the CustomXMLParts collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Gets a CustomXMLPart object from the CustomXMLParts collection. Read-only.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add([XML As String], [SchemaCollection As Variant]) As CustomXMLPart
methods.description: Allows you to add a new CustomXMLPart to a file.

parameters.name: XML
parameters.description: Contains the XML to add to the newly created CustomXMLPart.

parameters.name: SchemaCollection
parameters.description: Represents the set of schemas to be used to validate this stream.

methods.name: SelectByID
methods.description: Selects a custom XML part matching a GUID.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: Contains the GUID for the custom XML part.

methods.name: SelectByNamespace
methods.description: Selects the collection of custom XML parts whose namespace matches the search criteria.

events.name: PartAfterAdd
events.description: Occurs just after a CustomXMLPart object is added to the CustomXMLParts collection.

events.name: PartBeforeDelete
events.description: Occurs just before a CustomXMLPart object is deleted from the CustomXMLParts collection.

parameters.name: OldPart
parameters.description: The part that is about to be deleted.

events.name: PartAfterLoad
events.description: Occurs just after a CustomXMLPart object is loaded.
